description: This file defines a Java interface `StreamCacheConfig` for configuring a streaming cache in a search service, including methods to retrieve configuration parameters and an inner enum for default config values.

classes.name: StreamCacheConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration settings for the streaming cache of the Search service, extending CacheConfig, with methods to retrieve dispatcher name and retry delay.

classes.name: StreamCacheConfig.StreamCacheConfigValue
classes.description: An enumeration of known configuration path expressions and default values used within `StreamCacheConfig`.

methods.name: getDispatcherName
methods.description: Returns the name of the dispatcher to run async cache loaders which do not block threads.

methods.name: getRetryDelay
methods.description: Returns the delay before retrying a cache query if the cached value is out of date.
